item.title: [AI & I by Every] Best of the Pod: Wired's Kevin Kelly on Why AI Is a 50-year Overnight Success
item.description:
Speaker 1 | 00:00 - 00:28 What I've learned with the future is that it's easy to make predictions and hard to make predictions that are true. Gerard Lanier showed me VR in '87. I was completely blown away and I thought, oh my gosh, this is the future. The VR that we had back then is not that much different than the VR you get now. The difference was that was multimillion dollars and it's a $100.
Speaker 1 | 00:28 - 00:36 I've been very, very surprised about how slow that has been. You could say...
